checks: CSV row counts, pairing, improvement flags, repeat means, sample SD, repeat counts and improvement counts verified.
pooling: OOF across folds within repeat, then summary across repeats
pcc: Mean of valid per-timepoint PCC values after pooling all five outer-fold OOF predictions within each repeat.
delta_pcc: PCC_DynaGS minus PCC_baseline within the same repeat and trait; then arithmetic mean across five repeats.
intervals: No confidence intervals or significance tests shown; saved sample SD uses ddof=1.

display.A: Six models by eight traits; supplied mean PCC; no cell numbers.
display.B: Five baselines by eight traits; supplied mean paired delta PCC; dashed borders identify negative differences.
display.colorbars: Vertical, aligned with the full height of each heatmap.
